reviews.review_title: A TON OF FUN! Highly Recommend!
reviews.review_description:
Duck Z is an absolute blast! The concept of playing as a duck searching for gold in a creepy town filled with zombie ducks and other terrifying creatures is awesome. The horror atmosphere keeps you on your toes, and there are plenty of moments that will make you jump, laugh, and panic!

What really makes this game special is playing multiplayer with friends. We had an absolute blast exploring, surviving, getting scared, and having some hilarious moments along the way.

If you enjoy horror games, multiplayer chaos, and having fun with your friends, I definitely recommend giving Duck Z a try. I had a ton of fun playing it, and I can't wait to jump back in for more!

10/10 — Quack, scare, survive, repeat!
